statBlock.specialAbilities:
SRD type: Devil

Devils are fiends from lawful evil-aligned planes.

Many devils are surrounded by a fear aura, which they use to break up powerful groups and defeat opponents piecemeal. Devils with spell-like abilities use their illusion abilities to delude and confuse foes as much as possible. A favorite trick is to create illusory reinforcements; enemies can never be entirely sure if a threat is only a figment or real summoned devils joining the fray.

Devil Traits

Most devils possesses the following traits (unless otherwise noted in a creature’s entry).

  • Immunity to fire and poison.
  • Resistance to acid 10 and cold 10.
  • See in Darkness (Su): Some devils can see perfectly in darkness of any kind, even that created by a deeper darkness spell.
  • Summon (Sp): Some devils share the ability to summon others of their kind (the success chance and type of devils summoned are noted in each monster description).
  • Telepathy.

Except when otherwise noted, devils speak Infernal, Celestial, and Draconic.

Special Attacks: Entangle, spell-like abilities, summon devil

Special Qualities: Damage reduction 5/good, darkvision 60 ft., immunity to fire and poison, resistance to acid 10 and cold 10, see in darkness, spell resistance 20, telepathy 100 ft., true seeing

Imported from the d20 SRD; verify attacks and skills in-game. Full rules at d20srd.org.

system.biography:
Unlike other devils, erinyes appear attractive to humans, resembling very comely women or men. An erinyes stands about 6 feet tall and weighs about 150 pounds.

Erinyes speak Infernal, Celestial, and Draconic.

Combat

Erinyes prefer to engage in combat from a distance. They use charm monster to distract or disorganize their opponents, then rain down fiery arrows from above.

An erinyes’s natural weapons, as well as any weapons it wields, are treated as evil-aligned and lawful-aligned for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

Entangle (Ex)

Each erinyes carries a stout rope some 50 feet long that entangles opponents of any size as an animate rope spell (caster level 16th). An erinyes can hurl its rope 30 feet with no range penalty. Typically, an erinyes entangles a foe, lifts it into the air, and drops it from a great height.

Spell-Like Abilities

At will—greater teleport (self plus 50 pounds of objects only), charm monster (DC 19), minor image (DC 17), unholy blight (DC 19). Caster level 12th. The save DCs are Charisma-based.

Summon Devil (Sp)

Once per day an erinyes can attempt to summon 2d10 lemures or 1d4 bearded devils with a 50% chance of success. This ability is the equivalent of a 3rd-level spell.

True Seeing (Su)

Erinyes continuously use true seeing, as the spell (caster level 14th).

system.description: You are adept at dodging blows.
system.benefit: During your action, you designate an opponent and receive a +1 dodge bonus to Armor Class against attacks from that opponent. You can select a new opponent on any action.

system.description: You are skilled at dodging past opponents and avoiding their attacks.
system.benefit: You get a +4 dodge bonus to Armor Class against attacks of opportunity caused when you move out of or within a threatened area. A condition that makes you lose your Dexterity bonus to Armor Class (if any) also makes you lose dodge bonuses. Dodge bonuses stack with each other, unlike most types of bonuses.
system.special: A fighter may select Mobility as one of his fighter bonus feats.

system.description: You are skilled at making well-placed shots with ranged weapons at close range.
system.benefit: You get a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls with ranged weapons against opponents within 30 feet.

system.description: You are skilled at timing ranged attacks so that you avoid hitting your comrades.
system.benefit: You can shoot or throw ranged weapons at an opponent engaged in melee without taking the standard -4 penalty on your attack roll.
system.special: A fighter may select Precise Shot as one of his fighter bonus feats.

system.description: You can get multiple shots from a ranged weapon.
system.benefit: When using a bow (not a crossbow), you may fire one extra arrow per round. All of your attack rolls take a -2 penalty when using Rapid Shot.
system.special: A fighter may select Rapid Shot as one of his fighter bonus feats.

system.description: You can move, fire a ranged weapon, and move again before your foes can react.
system.prerequisites: Dex 13, Dodge, Mobility, Point Blank Shot, base attack bonus +4
system.benefit: As a full-round action, you can move up to your speed and make a single ranged attack at any point during your movement. You must move at least 10 feet before and after your shot. You may not take a 5-foot step before, during, or after this action.
system.special: A fighter may select Shot on the Run as one of his fighter bonus feats.

system.description: Make a Concentration check whenever you might be distracted (by taking damage, by harsh weather, and so on) while engaged in some action that requires your full attention.
You can use this skill to persuade others to agree with your arguments, to resolve differences, and to gather valuable information or rumors from people.
Make an Escape Artist check to slip out of bonds or escape from a grapple.
Make a Hide check to conceal yourself from enemies, slink past guards, slip away without being noticed, or sneak up on people without being seen or heard.
Ancient mysteries, magic traditions, arcane symbols, cryptic phrases, constructs, dragons, magical beasts. Like other Knowledge skills, each Knowledge field is a separate skill with its own ranks.
Your Listen check is either made against a DC that reflects how quiet the noise is that you might hear, or it is opposed by the target's Move Silently check.
Make a Move Silently check when you try to sneak past enemies or move without being heard.
You can find secret doors, traps, and hidden objects.
You can get a hunch about a social situation or read a person.
Your Spot check is either made against a DC that reflects how obvious the object is, or it is opposed by the target's Hide check.
You are skilled at surviving in the wild and at following tracks.
Most tasks with a rope are relatively simple. The DCs for various tasks utilizing this skill are summarized on the table below.

Entangle (Ex): Stout rope (often ~50 ft.) functions like animate rope (high caster level); can be hurled with range listed in the stat block.

Spell-like abilities: At will — greater teleport (self plus light load), charm monster, minor image, unholy blight; save DCs Charisma-based — CL per statistics.

Summon devil (Sp): Daily — lemures or bearded devils as listed; chance of success per entry.

True seeing (Su): Continuous, as the spell — CL per statistics.

Weapons: Natural and wielded weapons often count as evil and lawful for overcoming DR.

What it does (SRD): The creature ignores the first N points of damage from each attack or effect of the listed energy type.

ThirdEra: Type and amount are set under CGS parameters and overrides (merged over an empty template grant list).

What it does (SRD): The creature is immune to poison: it does not take ability damage or hit point damage from poison, and it ignores other harmful poison effects unless a specific effect overrides immunity.

ThirdEra: On this item’s Details tab, poison immunity is under Capability grants (immunity), not as save or AC bonuses in Mechanical effects. The character sheet lists it with other immunities and defenses from the creature’s items and features.
